title: PR body still claims audio.dem proves "ALL FOUR kinds" — the same claim its own W1 fold declares false
evidence:
`audio.dem` now proves ALL FOUR kinds fire (wire via its 100 ms draws); the new `audio_spawn.dem` (T1-only, growth on) proves the spawn chime + wire in a growth context. ... +- **W1 — "ALL FOUR kinds" reworded** (`harness/run.odin`, `demos/audio.dem`
+  header): audio.dem proves crisis+arrival+wire; spawn lives in audio_spawn.dem
+  (no growth on audio.dem — the claim was false). ... +- `demos/audio.dem` — header updated (all four kinds); `demos/audio_spawn.dem` — new spawn golden.
detail: audio.dem runs with growth off, so NODE_SPAWNED cannot fire there; the shipped demo header and run.odin guard cover three kinds. W1's reword fixed code comments but not the PR body's own bullets.

title: Wire placeholder's "low thump under it" is appended after the tock, not layered under it
evidence:
+// mid low-mid sweep + a low thump under it (the Brush low+mid stack).
...
+		click_append(&out, f0s[slot], f1s[slot], 0.055, 0.6)
+		tone_append(&out, thumps[slot], 0.05, 0.45)
detail: tone_append is append-only (per the W2 note); the thump occupies 55–105 ms after the tock ends, not layered "under" it — the same sequential-vs-mixed defect W2 fixed for spawn.
recommended_fix: Mix thump and tock in one summed window (chime_append-style), or change the comment to "followed by a low thump".
